evidence: SOURCE. task/tests/scoring.toml is byte-identical to the template (sha256 95f70d6e...): [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6, polish 0.2, visual 0.2 (sum 1.0, no gate key); [floors] functional = 0.05. task/tests/tools/score.py (13de2b38..., identical to template) and test.sh (bd682592..., identical) are unchanged shared harness. score.py:40-41 gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor) over [gates]; :43-44 scored dimensions are forced to 0.0 unless gates_passed and scored reward.json exists; :46 weighted sums only [weights] keys, so gates carry zero reward mass; :47-48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed (functional > 0.05), else 0.0; :83 returns 1 on gate failure. test.sh: write_zero_reward runs first; run_suite gates 1500 then score.py; case 1) exit 0 -> scored suite is never launched on gate failure; any score.py error (2) -> write_zero_reward; scored suite failure/timeout -> exit 0 leaving the zero reward. Gate judges (task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:14-21, constraints/judge.toml:14-21) each hold one binary criterion with [scoring] aggregation = "all_pass", so a gate dimension is exactly 0 or 1; no partial-credit leakage through the > 0.0 threshold. GATES EXCLUDE DEAD APPS (REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'): hro_gate_render requires a wrong-password refusal then a real Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'); hro_gate_shared requires a UI-created job and candidate read back by the Observer in a new independent browser context ('A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'). Both rely only on public brief facts (instruction.md:17 accounts/password; hireops_rules.md:18 Observer reads the board; :28 places 1-50; :32 new card at bottom of Applied). Each scored prompt repeats the same minimal backend check and zeroes every criterion on failure (functional prompt 'gives every binary criterion 0'; visual prompt 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'), a second line of defence if gates were bypassed. MEASURED (offline, no Docker): ran the frozen score.py+scoring.toml on synthetic RewardKit outputs, evidence/43/score_sim.txt (sha256 2fb4659f...): render=0 with perfect scored -> reward 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 with no scored -> 0.0, exit 1; gates pass, functional 2.0/58.5 with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0 (weighted 0.4205 withheld by floor); functional exactly 0.05 -> 0.0 (strict >); gates pass but scored suite missing -> 0.0; all full -> 1.0. FLOOR ADEQUACY: functional criteria total weight 58.5 (43 binary criteria); clearing the 0.05 floor needs > 2.925 weight, i.e. more than the gate-adjacent trivia (hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 = 2.0 -> 0.034 -> reward 0). WEAK-APP PROBE: a gate-passing app that also does single-stage moves (+1.5 -> 3.5/58.5 = 0.060) clears the floor and could take up to 0.2 from visual plus some polish (e.g. session resume 2.5/12), reward ~0.24-0.28 with ~6% functional; it is a working (if thin) app, not a non-working one, so this is a reward-ordering/weight-honesty matter for rows 42/44, and the floor value is template-controlled and may not be changed here. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBE: a correct app that labels the first stage 'Applied', puts new cards there, gives the Observer read access and persists server-side passes both gates; gates require no route, selector or wording. A conforming app could fail only via evaluator/tool failure, which the gate prompts route to binary 0 'NOT EXERCISED' (a zero reward, honestly labelled, not a mis-grade). RISK=true because the full configured verifier path was not executed: no hosted/Docker run shows RewardKit writing gates/reward.json keyed render/constraints, nor a real gate-failing app yielding reward 0 with the scored suite skipped; raw-evidence-index.json scope says reward discrimination/ranking evidence is absent. My score.py simulation is not a substitute for that runtime record.
